build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball into a jar with a staircase of bars in the way
create_staircase_bars: create five angled static bars arranged as a staircase using C.add with bar_top and bar_left helpers
add_jar_and_guards: add a static jar with left and right guard bars aligned to a target staircase bar
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the jar using C.update_task with TOUCHING relationship
set_solution_meta: set the solution metadata tier to BALL using C.set_meta with SolutionTier.BALL
